description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Icon model within the Goteo application, testing creation, validation, and deletion behaviors.

classes.name: IconTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the Icon model, testing creation, validation, retrieval, and deletion.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Icon model and verifies it's of the correct class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests validation and save methods on a new Icon instance.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Icon with predefined data, verifies validation, saves it, retrieves it, and deletes it.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a non-existing Icon and attempts to delete it.
